items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Johnny Hodges was the prime first influence... I was trying to emulate Johnny Hodges

ctx.x: But when you were there, were you checking Johnny Hodges and Benny Carter

Right. I used to play all of Johnny Hodges’ solos. Benny Carter came through and wrote an arrangement for our college band. We played that. There were some nice cats. Tab Smith came through. At that time, Tab was playing with Count Basie’s band. But he was from Wilson, North Carolina, so he was a North Carolinian.
When were you discharged from the Navy?
